🏆 WORLD CLASS 15/15 CHECKLIST: ✅ WALT/WILF ✅ Prior Knowledge ✅ CRA ✅ Dual Coding ✅ 3 Analogies + Where Breaks ✅ Examples Non-Examples ✅ Worked Faded Scratch ✅ Misconceptions ✅ Checks 3-4 min ✅ Metacognition ✅ Elaboration What If ✅ Retrieval 3Qs ✅ Differentiation 🌱🌿🌳 ✅ Real World India Ethics Joy ✅ Project Real Audience Portfolio — GOLD STANDARD

👩‍🏫 Teacher Training — World Class

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 6 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 6 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0

LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON

❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0

MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare 🇮🇳India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop 🇮🇳
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line! 🇮🇳
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink! 🇮🇳
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢

1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10

Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 7 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 7 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 7 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

Bias b: 0

👩‍🏫 Teacher Training — World Class

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 7 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 7 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 7 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

Photo Grade 7 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first

Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 7 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 7 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 8 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 8 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

👩‍🏫 Teacher Training — World Class

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 8 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 8 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare 🇮🇳India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop 🇮🇳
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line! 🇮🇳
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink! 🇮🇳
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold

Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 8 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

👩‍🏫 Teacher Training — World Class

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 8 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 8 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?

Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌

Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow

AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢

1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10

Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

👩‍🏫 Teacher Training — World Class

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 8 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 8 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 8 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 8 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON

❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer

👩‍🏫 Teacher Training — World Class

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 9 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 9 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10

👩‍🏫 Teacher Training — World Class

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 9 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🧠 Mental Model Deep — World Class CRA + Dual Coding

🟢 Concrete: Real socks 10 pairs touch
Photo Grade 9 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first
🟡 Representational: Draw icons bar chart
Draw striped icon 3 vs plain 7 bar SVG
🔵 Abstract: Rule If stripe then A symbolic w·x+b
Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit
🎨 60-sec Sketch 4 Steps Animated + Draw-Along Large Dotted Finger Trace + Audio 🔊
Step1 Circle sock 🧦
Step2 3 arrows w1 w2 w3 →
Step3 bias box I like blue 💙
Step4 bulb Pattern found! 💡

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 9 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0

LED ON Pattern found!

❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 9 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

Photo Grade 9 kid sorting — hands-on — touch first

Rule: If stripe → Basket A else B — Light math w·x+b — bridge explicit

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 9 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON

❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps

👩‍🏫 Teacher Training — World Class

🎯 WALT/WILF Bronze/Silver/Gold
Bronze: I can find pattern in 10 socks
Silver: I can explain pattern and test on new socks
Gold: I can create new pattern and explain where analogy breaks
🧠 Prior Knowledge Activation 2 min Think-Pair-Share
How do you organize bookshelf? Toys? WhatsApp messages? Partner talk 30 sec first
🔬 Learning Science Why Works
Brain learns best: Touch → Picture → Rule (CRA) + See + Say + Do (Dual Coding) + Quiz without looking (Retrieval). Grade 9 needs movement every 10-12 min.
MisconceptionWhy Kids ThinkFix What to SayVisual Fix
AI sees like humanMovies show robots with eyesAI counts pixels, not sees like you👁️ vs 🔢
More data always betterPhone storage more = betterMessy data = messy patterns🧹 Messy Room 80%
1 example = pattern1 sock looks like patternPattern needs repeat to predict1 vs 10
🚧 Where this analogy breaks — Don't think...
Don't think socks = data — socks you can touch, data invisible. Don't think sorting once = AI training — AI needs 1000s examples. Common Wrong: Many think weight=0 ignores input — correct, but bias still matters, LED may still ON — What If: What if bias +5? → always ON

💡 Examples — World Class 6 Cards Worked Faded Scratch + Example Non-Example + Oops Monster + What If Slider

🧦 Sock Sorting Home+10 XP
Story: Riya has 10 socks 3 striped 7 plain
💭 Think Aloud: I notice striped repeats 3 times. I wonder if striped is pattern?
Example Non-Example: Ex: 3 striped together = pattern ✅ Non: 1 random = not pattern ❌
😱 Oops! Common Wrong: Many think more socks = striped but actually 70% plain
What If: What if all dotted? → no pattern — Ethics: 🟢 Green — Case Study: Spotify
🛺 Hyderabad Auto! Fare India +10 XP
Story: Hyderabad auto 30 Rs 2km 60 Rs 4km
💭 Think Aloud: I notice 30→60 double — I wonder fare = 15*km?
Example Non-Example: Day fare 15*km = pattern ✅ Night random not pattern ❌
What If: What if night bias +20? → fare =15*km+20 slider
Common Wrong: Many think fare always double but night bias +20
Ethics: 🟡 Yellow
🌧️ Monsoon Crop
Rice needs rain 100mm good 20mm poor — monsoon pattern — Example Non-Example Rain pattern ✅ Random sunny not pattern ❌ — What If no monsoon? → crop fails
🏏 Virat + Line!
Virat ball trajectory straight line pattern — Example Non-Example Straight line pattern ✅ Random bounce not pattern ❌ — What If spin? → curve
🪔 Diwali Blink!
Diwali lights blink pattern festive — Example Non-Example Blink every 2 sec pattern ✅ Random flicker not pattern ❌ — What If all on? → no pattern
🎵 Spotify Music
Songs you like pattern — Example Non-Example 3 pop = pattern ✅ 1 random not pattern ❌ — What If pop and rock? → need 2 patterns — Ethics Yellow who decides?

🧪 Physical Lab — World Class CRA + 3 Levels + Failure Museum + Simulator

1️⃣ Mix socks Shuffle 10 🎒
2️⃣ Sort 60 sec ⏱️ +10 XP
3️⃣ Count 30% striped 🔢
4️⃣ Find pattern 💡
🎮 Simulator Big Slider Green→Red Big LED Glowing w·x+b Live
Color weight w1: 1.0
Stripe weight w2: 2.0
Bias b: 0
💡
LED ON Pattern found!
Common Wrong: weight=0 ignores input but bias still matters LED may still ON — What If bias +5? → always ON
🏛️ Failure Museum 3 fails ❌→✅ What learned?
❌ Sorted by color not pattern → ✅ Look repeat not color — learned pattern not color
❌ Only 2 socks → ✅ Need 10 to see pattern — learned more data clearer
❌ 50% not clear → ✅ Pool class 60 socks 72% clear — learned pooling helps
